purpose: L2-dev Flash cold-boot package built from repository-bundled inputs: OpenVela CP app.bin, the bundled vendor Bootloader, and a synthetic AP placeholder

relationship_to_vendor_profile.shared: identical container encoding, partition layout, and staged-Bootloader construction
relationship_to_vendor_profile.differs: requires no Armino SDK or beken_genie build tree, and places a synthetic AP placeholder instead of the locked vendor AP payload
relationship_to_vendor_profile.trust_anchor: tests/test_bk7258_packaging.py asserts the repository container encoder reproduces the SDK packer byte-for-byte; that check needs the vendor tree and stays machine-local

ap_placeholder.form: synthetic payload, contains no vendor code

staged_bootloader.construction: normal_bootloader padded with 0x00 to a 32-byte boundary, followed by the 256-byte serialized partition table
staged_bootloader.note: identical to the vendor profile's staged Bootloader, which is why the bundled Bootloader partition is byte-for-byte the vendor one

partition_table.record_layout: Serialize bk_ota_partitions.json.part_table in source-array order; each entry is 64 bytes: little-endian magic, NUL-padded 24-byte name, NUL-padded 24-byte flash_name, little-endian offset, little-endian len, and little-endian CRC32 over the preceding 60 bytes.

ap_placeholder_contract.rationale: The L0 contract keeps the secondary cores unreleased, so the AP partition only has to be occupied by a well-formed payload. The placeholder parks the core in a self-branch loop instead of leaving 0xff padding at the AP vector base.

hardware_observation.flash_evidence: bk_loader 2.1.11.8 reported Last 4K CRC_Verify ->pass, WriteFlash ->pass, Enprotect pass and Writing Flash OK
hardware_observation.console_result: operator-reported working; one ?/help long-output command completed without another input event, confirming the UART TX FIFO-drain fix. No UART log was captured for this run, so the console outcome is not recorded evidence

established: the vendor Bootloader still boots CP when the AP partition holds only the 66-byte placeholder instead of the locked vendor payload
the UART TX FIFO-drain fix completes one ?/help long output without another input event
not_verified: whether the vendor Bootloader inspects or validates the AP partition at all
AP release, peripherals, networking, USB and sustained operation
ap_placeholder_contract.acceptance_note: One bundled image has been flashed and cold-booted on a DevKit, which is why the placeholder is no longer speculative. The operator also confirmed the UART TX FIFO-drain long-output retest, but did not retain a UART capture. Still keep the locked vendor recovery all-app.bin (sha256 1613a6018553de9ebb0564572b090844253688af53c9bcc3de7c5b40f06db89d) available and capture the UART log on a future run so the console result becomes recorded evidence.
